The real danger is p3's hotels on the light blues, and since I'm heading toward spaces 6, 8, 9, I need to keep enough cash buffered to survive that stretch.

Trading or buying Park Place from p4 feels too risky right now since it'd leave me cash-poor with Boardwalk still mortgaged and no funds to build, so I'll just end my turn.
